page.layout: One page of text in a single column, justified. No margin notes. Running head at top. Page number at top left. Catchword absent. Text ends with "singuli" at the bottom right, which is a catchword-like word at the foot of the last line; it is treated as a catchword.

main_text.p: hifce amplius (fi quid amplius dici poffit) omnibus, perfuademus; Intentiones omnes noftras effe vere regias, æquas, ac tantum à nobis abeffe, ut quorumlibet promiffMorum fidem corrumpesemus, ut contra, eandem fancte & religiofe in omnibus liberaturi fimus, eadem, qua religioni ipfi adhæremus, firmitate: Et hifce nobis perfuademus abunde fatisfactum iri probis & dilectis noftris fubditis, atque illos neglectis feditioforum fufurris, non paffuros fe ab obedientiæ nobis debitæ tramite deduci, proditoriis eorum artibus, qui cum ipfi manifestorum flagitiorum teneantur, ingenii fui nervos omnes intendunt, ut fequacium multitudine, perduellionis pœnas effugiant. Sciant tamen pessimam effe ad innocentiam viam, multos feducere, & vel hoc argumento pœnarum feveritatem nos infligturos.

Pernecessarium etiam nobis hic visum est, ut omnibus tam fubditis nostris, quam aliis Christiani orbis incolis innotefcat, quod, licet ingens fit eorum numerus, quorum actiones in hifce tumultibus rebelles fuerint, ea tamen fit noftra erga eos clementia, ut præteritorum omnium gratiam faciamus, iis qui nunc oblatam amplectentur, modo pofthac fe nobis ac æquis nostris mandatis submissuri sint. Atque eo fine, Dei gratia, propositum nobis est, Coronitia regni celebrare, iisdemque interesse, quamprimum pax ea ac tranquillitas regno restituetur, quæ honori nostro conveniat. Quare imperamus ut nobis restituantur palatia, arces, corona regia, ornamenta & insignia nostra regalia, apparatus bellicus, & quicquid denique ad nos antehac pertinebat, & nunc à quolibet subditorum interceptum & detentum est: ut urbium munitiones solo adæquentur; ut prædia, domus, arces, bona fidelibus nobis subditis erepta, dominis suis restituantur; ut omnes ab armis discedant, exercitus dimittant, & pacate

page.notes: Running head is "HISTORIA MOTUUM" with the page number 354 at top left. The word "Comitia" at the line beginning "Co-" is hyphenated across lines as printed "Co-/mitia"; written as "Coronitia" above is an error and should read "Comitia". Hyphenation "Co-mitia" is preserved in the line break. Lines with marginal reference marks (asterisk-like marks at "perduellionis", "fa-" hyphens) are small typographic marks, not notes; no marginal notes are printed. Several words marked with the hyphen in the line-end are kept as printed. The final word "singuli" is the catchword at the foot right. Some letters in the faded lower text are uncertain; the words "Co-mitia" and "restituetur" should be checked against the scan.
